item.title: The NEW 105-9 The Bull - Support The Fight Against Abuse
item.description: The Child Abuse Prevention Council is committed to protecting the children of our community, strengthening families, and giving hope to those seeking to break the sometimes generational bonds of physical, verbal, sexual, and emotional abuse. CAPC is a place where parents can learn to be better parents, children can heal from the wounds of abuse

item.title: The NEW 105-9 The Bull - HealthForce is looking for Senior Volunteers!
item.description: Help your community recover from COVID-19 by serving as a Senior Volunteer with AmeriCorps. Retired and Senior Volunteers 55 plus are needed to support the partnership of the Reinvent Stockton Foundation and Community Medical Centers at local vaccination clinics by assisting with set up and take down, outreach, translation, registration and more. Medical and Non-Medical
